# Romir Kapoor

<p class="home-tagline">Exploring the intersection of data analytics, economics, and business strategy.</p>

I'm a senior at the **University of California, Los Angeles**, double majoring in **Mathematics/Economics** and **Statistics & Data Science**, graduating in June 2027.

Through my experience in consulting, data analytics, and student leadership, I enjoy combining quantitative analysis with strategic thinking to solve real-world problems. Following graduation, I'll be returning to **Accenture** as a Management Consulting Analyst in its Sourcing & Procurement practice in Fall 2027.
